item.title: The Truth About the Charismatic Movement
item.description: Justin Peters examines the history, leaders, and doctrines of the Charismatic movement and evaluates it biblically, calling believers to discernment and truth.

item.title: Ezra 7: Ezra’s Example and a Heart Set on God’s Word
item.description: Ezra 7 reveals Ezra’s devotion to studying, obeying, and teaching God’s Word. Discover how spiritual renewal begins with a heart set on Scripture.

item.title: The Wonder of the Incarnation
item.description: Discover why the Incarnation matters Jesus and how this truth shapes the gospel, the Christian life, and our worship and everything this Christmas season.

item.title: Christ Our Atoning Savior and Our Need for Redemption
item.description: This Advent, explore why we need atonement and how Christ alone redeems, justifies, and reconciles sinners through His obedient life and substitutionary death.

item.title: Standing Firm in the Truth in a Confused Age
item.description: Christians can discern truth in a confused culture by grounding themselves in Scripture, testing everything, walking humbly, and seeking wise community.

item.title: Battling Pride with Humility | Warriors of Grace Podcast
item.description: Discover how Christian men can confront pride through Christlike humility. Dave Jenkins teaches Philippians 2:3–8 in this Warriors of Grace episode.

item.title: Ezra 8 — Trusting God on the Journey
item.description: Ezra 8 shows God’s protection and guidance as Ezra leads the exiles to Jerusalem. Learn how prayer, trust, and integrity shape the journey of faith.

item.title: Yoga and Spiritual Warfare, Why Christians Must Reject It
item.description: Why yoga is not neutral. Dave Jenkins and Doreen Virtue explain the pagan roots of yoga, its spiritual dangers, and why Christians must reject it biblically.
